attribute.name: DQMConfig
attribute.description: If non-empty then read DQM configuration from given database.

attribute.name: UpdateInterval
attribute.description: Do not store result if update happens within UpdateInterval (in seconds) since last saved result and result status and tags did not change.

attribute.name: AddConfigHist
attribute.description: Add histograms from DQParameter configuration to the result when saving histograms, by default only histograms in the result itself are saved.

attribute.name: QueueSize
attribute.description: Size of the internal result queue.

attribute.name: ISWorkerThreads
attribute.description: IS receiver worker threads count, 0 means use default value.

attribute.name: ServerName
attribute.description: IS server name to read data from.

attribute.name: StorageDir
attribute.description: Directory where archive files will be stored (before sending to CoCa).

attribute.name: CoCaDataset
attribute.description: Dataset name in which archives will be stored in CoCa. If dataset name is not defined or empty then archives are not to be sent to CoCa.

attribute.name: CoCaPriority
attribute.description: Priority for CoCa cache management system

attribute.name: CoCaDTC
attribute.description: Desired Time in Cache (in seconds) for CoCa cache management system

attribute.name: CoCaPartition
attribute.description: Partition in which the CoCa server is running

attribute.name: CheckpointMinutes
attribute.description: Checkpoint interval in minutes to flush TTrees into a file, 0 to disable

attribute.name: MaxFileTimeIntervalSec
attribute.description: Limit on time period stored in one file in seconds, 0 for no limit

attribute.name: MaxFileResultCount
attribute.description: Limit on number of results stored in one file, 0 for no limit

attribute.name: FinalizeTimeoutSec
attribute.description: Timeout on finalization process in seconds, if timeout expires then transition completes but finalization continues in background (but will be killed with application). 0 means infinite timeout.

relationship.name: CoCaServer
relationship.description: CoCa server, optional, if not defined then no archiving to CoCa
